biotools.summary: OpenStructure is an open-source computational framework for structural biology, enabling benchmarking of protein structures, protein-protein interfaces, and protein-ligand complexes. It provides tools for automated scoring of tertiary and quaternary structures and is designed to scale efficiently for large systems.
